name: SCGBHD
recent: Southern Cable 最新季度净利按年增长26.5%至RM45.2百万，营收亦走高。同期，公司因雇员公积金局（EPF）连续多日申报持股变动，以及凭单转换为新股而多次发布额外上市公告。
notable: 最新季度净利按年增长26.5%至RM45.2百万，营收亦走高。
雇员公积金局（EPF）在2026年10月至11月期间多次申报持股变动。
因凭单转换为新股，公司多次发布额外上市公告。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在2026年10月至11月期间连续多日申报持股变动，显示大股东持股出现变化。
凭单持续转换为新股并上市，可能增加流通股数量。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为RM527.6百万，按季增长21.9%，按年增长25.8%；净利为RM40.6百万，按季增长22.3%，按年增长28.2%；净利率为7.7%，与上季持平。

recent_en: Southern Cable's latest quarterly net profit rose 26.5% year-on-year to RM45.2 million on higher sales. Meanwhile, the company issued multiple additional listing announcements due to warrant conversions and received repeated substantial shareholder notices from the Employees Provident Fund Board.
notable_en: Latest quarterly net profit rose 26.5% year-on-year to RM45.2 million on higher sales.
The Employees Provident Fund Board filed multiple substantial shareholder notices between October and November 2026.
The company issued several additional listing announcements due to warrant conversions into new shares.
risks_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board filed substantial shareholder notices on consecutive days between October and November 2026, indicating changes in major shareholding.
Warrants continue to be converted into new shares and listed, potentially increasing the number of shares in circulation.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM527.6 million, up 21.9% QoQ and 25.8% YoY; net income was RM40.6 million, up 22.3% QoQ and 28.2% YoY; net margin was 7.7%, unchanged from the previous quarter.
